ache.title: An ‘easy guide’ to a system that needed a Discord
ache.note: Ash Echoes’ gearing is called one of the game’s most complex systems, and it took a Discord community to unravel: leaders, traces, prep for Nexus runs. When a game needs a crowd to explain it, the confusion becomes part of the hook; you stay to finally ‘get it.’ Early-game prep can quietly turn into a second job.
watch: traces and leaders to keep tuning
ache.tip: If a game needs homework to enjoy, give it a set time and stop when the timer rings.

videoData.title: Gearing & Leadership: Easy Guide! | Ash Echoes

textData.text: In this video, I delve into one of the most complex aspects of Ash Echoes: the gearing system. With the help of the community on the Discord server, I've unraveled how to effectively organize your characters and utilize the leader mechanics. From choosing a leader, whether it's the director or a trained character, to understanding the importance of traces and their impact on your team, I cover it all. This detailed guide will help you navigate the early stages of the game and prepare your team for success in the Nexus runs. Join me, Nero Atlas, as I break down the essentials and share tips on gearing and leadership in Ash Echoes. Don't forget to comment with any questions or observations, and stay tuned for more videos. See you soon in the game!
